properties.name: Ember Keeper
properties.description: A three-minute circuit-keeping game: route energy through six valves, then give the small flame room to breathe.
properties.author: CC

objects.name: Subtitle
objects.string: A small flame. Six ways to save it.

content.text: A small flame. Six ways to save it.

objects.name: Controls
objects.string: 1–6 / click: valve   SPACE: close all   P: pause   R: restart

content.text: 1–6 / click: valve   SPACE: close all   P: pause   R: restart

objects.name: IntroBody
objects.string:
Open the GOLD valve before an energy pulse.
VIOLET previews the next route.

Try 3 feeds, then CLOSE ALL for 1 cooling pulse.
Even one valve makes heat. An empty ember dies.
